svg.title: Urban traffic induced demand
svg.desc: A causal-loop diagram of Urban traffic induced demand. 5 variables are joined by 5 causal links, each carrying its polarity beside the arrowhead. The engine's job here is to find the feedback loops and classify them by Sterman's even/odd rule, and this drawing shows that answer: B1 runs Travel time → Driving attractiveness → Vehicle trips → Congestion → Travel time with 1 negative link, so it balances. Each loop glyph is a circular arrow curling in the loop's own direction, labelled with the computed letter and the loop's name.
